findings.source: ConvertibleDepositFacility.sol:318-336 for (...) { ... _previewConvert(...) -> DEPOS.getPosition(positionId_) ... revert CDF_NotOwner(positionId_) ... DEPOS.setRemainingDeposit(...) }
findings.issue: In the main loops of this unoptimized build, DEPOS.getPosition loses its name and argument (P2, 11 lines) and the custom errors (CDF_NotOwner, CDF_PositionExpired, CDF_InvalidAmount, ...) are raw-memory reverts, although '_108 - mem[64]' is 0 (no store to slot 64 after _108 = mem[64]); the returned Position struct is visible only as memory slices (P18).
findings.rule: Prove mem[64] >= 128 (it only grows from 128 under the Panic(65) bounds) so stores at mem[64] + k do not alias slot 64; copy-propagate _x = mem[64] and decode the call's selector and arguments, and 'revert memory' of selector + words as 'revert with sel, args'.

findings.source: requestPermissions: requests = new Permissions[](5); requests[0] = Permissions(toKeycode("MINTR"), MINTR.increaseMintApproval.selector) ...; configureDependencies: dependencies = new Keycode[](4)
findings.issue: Constant-count (5 and 4) Keycode/Permissions encoding loops are not unrolled, keycodes print as hex words instead of 'MINTR'/'DEPOS', and the return is a raw memory range; the new Permissions[](5) initialisation is rotated (P3).
findings.rule: Unroll loops with a small constant trip count and fold the copies; print a word of printable ASCII followed by zero bytes, stored as a bytes5 keycode, as a string literal.

notes: Unoptimized build (solc 0.8.36 noopt). All 47 ABI functions compared; convert (317 lines), previewConvert (217), the deposit/withdraw/yield functions (119-146 lines) by structure (checks, calls, storage writes, events, reverts), the rest in full. No semantic error found; e.g. configureDependencies' 10 ** decimals check folds the zero exponent into the 'OHM decimals' revert and keeps the checked-exponentiation helper loop ('while u > 1', readable) for exponents >= 78. Loops: the three source for-loops (claimAllYield over assets, previewConvert and convert over positionIds_) are readable whiles. The other 6 whiles are implicit: getOperators' storage-to-memory copy (P7), the rotated Permissions[] initialisation (P3), the 5- and 4-element encodings (P7), claimAllYield's address[] decoding and the exponentiation helper. P9: the FullMath.mulDiv of the conversion price expanded (_157/_158 Newton iterations).
summary: Faithful on the paths checked with all three source loops readable; as an unoptimized build it is verbose, with raw-memory calls and custom-error reverts inside the convert loops and an expanded mulDiv.
